svg.text: Team X67 · Enner Valencia — electrical schematic (rev 2, 24 Nov 2026)
Classic Arduino Nano (ATmega328P) · MG90 servo · 4 × TOF400C (VL53L1X) · BMI160 · ESP32-S3-CAM · TB6612FNG · CN3903 buck
VM = battery · VCC = +5 V · STBY tied to +5 V
XS = XSHUT pin: set LOW at start-up, then released one by one to give each sensor its address.
• Coloured lines are real wires between the parts shown.
• Pins with the same net name (+5 V, GND, VBAT, SDA, SCL)
are connected: the net label replaces a long wire.
• Power: one 5 V rail from the CN3903 buck output (red).
• The Nano is powered from the battery through VIN.
